_page: Events (Content → Events → New event): /media/events (list, grouped upcoming / past) and /media/events/<address>. Keyed by the Admin form's panels and field labels in order. Copied from apps/web/src/content/media.js (EVENTS) — these are the website's SAMPLE events. The website's events have no time zone, venue address, map link or registration link; every such value below is PROPOSED (marked ⚠ in the note here, not in the values) so that no field is empty — confirm the real venue, address, links and time zone before publishing. Time zone: Asia/Kolkata is proposed because the organization's office is in Pune. Once any event is published, the CMS list replaces the website's own events, so publish the set together.

_proposed_values: Time zone (Asia/Kolkata), the Pune address, the map links, the registration links (the website's own Contact and Volunteer pages, since no registration service exists yet) and the extra schedule steps are proposals — the website shows only 'Community Centre', 'Full address shared when you register', the start/end times and a three-step schedule. Replace them with the real details before Submit for review. A timed step must fall between the start and the end, and the end must be after the start.
Publishing: Create → Save → Submit for review → an owner Approves → the website Publish puts the event live. The website shows the times exactly as entered, naming the time zone.
